title: Gentle Weaning from the Screen: A Routine Without Battles
summary: Tantrums when turning off the screen are natural because the child has not yet developed self-control. Warn them a few minutes before turning it off, and transition to a beloved activity rather than leaving a void. Consistency with the rule in a calm manner gradually reduces battles.
try_this: This week: Before turning off the screen, give a warning («five minutes left»), then immediately transition to an activity they love.
reflection_prompts: How does your child react when screen time ends?
